Use Hide to tray to keep monitoring. Closing the window quits. Ctrl+H hides; Ctrl+Q quits. These two shortcuts apply while this window is focused.

F6 and Shift+F6 move between the header, navigation and page. Use arrows to choose a page, then Tab to enter it. Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+9 open the nine pages in sidebar order. Ctrl+F focuses sensor or game search. Escape closes a menu or file chooser.
Show OMEN Control or toggle the status overlay from any application. Choose keys in your desktop's shortcut dialog; enabling restores them next launch.
Install OMEN Control's desktop launcher to enable global shortcuts
Overlay preference is saved when toggled
Compact monitoring window. Move it with your desktop's window controls. Placement above games and visibility in full screen depend on the compositor.

Optional temperature notifications are informational, not thermal protection. They do not change hardware settings and work only while the application is running. Desktop notification settings also apply.
Notify when a temperature reaches the threshold
User settings contain desktop preferences, dashboard metrics, notification preferences, custom games and profile bindings. Review a backup before applying it; restart to refresh the app.
Service policies contain fan curves, lighting presets and battery automation. Applying them requires administrator authorization and may activate automation for all users.
The report can include machine and BIOS details, sensor readings, network information, device state and service configuration. Review it before sharing; it is saved to the local file you choose.
